title: Star Wars Episode I - Jedi Power Battles

match.zip: Star Wars Episode I - Jedi Power Battles.zip

sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health; Force meter; lives
Pick a Jedi from Episode I; each plays a little differently

Saber combos, Force push, deflect blasters (block)
Jump attacks and combos; blocking deflects blaster bolts back at droids

Darth Maul and droid bosses
Darth Maul is the final fight; droidekas need blocks before you can close in
Episode I locations, from the Trade Federation ship to Naboo

Health, Force, extra lives
Health and Force refills from pickups; extra lives are rare

Hidden items
Hidden pickups in side paths of each level
Extra lives are hidden in side paths

Levels cleared
Levels in film order to the duel with Darth Maul
